title: Scenario III: The Gate of Cedars

waves.advisorWarning: Zalpa: Enemy vanguard spotted descending from the Northern Defile! Form ranks and hold the gorge!
Zalpa: More raiders charging down the Eastern Valley with torches! Deploy our War Chariots to flank them on the open ground!
Tarkhunta: Shardana arsonists in the cedar groves! Protect our donkey caravans and the charcoal routes!
Burna-Khabir: The chieftain of the highland raiders leads their final assault! Unleash the thunder of our chariots and cleanse the pass!

primary.description: Erect a War Chariot Stables and train at least 2 Royal War Chariots to control the open valley passes.
Fell ancient cedars and stockpile at least 350 units of Timber to feed the bronze smelters with charcoal.
Repel all 4 overland assault waves surging through the northern and eastern passes.

secondary.description: Ensure the War Chariot Stables remain standing throughout the battle.
L'Imboscata nei Boschi: Destroy the Shardana forward raider outpost in the northeastern cedar woods before minute 8:00 (480s).

narrative.briefing: Year 1179 BC. High in the Lebanon Mountain Passes, smoke rises above the ancient cedar canopy. The Sea Peoples have altered their assault: unable to pierce our coastal ramparts, their warbands now march inland to incinerate our timber groves and starve the foundries of charcoal. Construct the War Chariot Stables, unleash our 2-horse bronze war chariots across the open valley floor, crush the hidden forward ambush camp in the northeastern woods, and bar the Gate of Cedars!

dialogues.speaker: burna_khabir
dialogues.message: My Wanax, the cedars of Lebanon are sacred to gods and kings. If the barbarians incinerate these groves, our foundries will die and our people will be cast into the dark.

dialogues.speaker: zalpa
dialogues.message: The Royal War Chariots roll forth! With composite horn bows and bronze-rimmed wheels, we shall outflank the sea raiders across the open valley floor!

dialogues.speaker: tarkhunta
dialogues.message: The donkey teams are hauling mountainous stacks of cedar logs! The charcoal pits are burning hot—our foundries will sing with molten bronze!
